_comment: Scenario battery for Intuitive Health And Wellness's Node 3 (claude-haiku-4-5, Override: Disabled, agent_transfer clinic -> inherits nodes/shared_agent_transfer/system_prompt.txt at runtime). Created 2026-09-02 when location_id_map was switched from '' (fully dynamic -- LOCATION step's INDEPENDENT COUNT/Parse instructions counted locations from a tool response that does not exist yet at that point in the flow) to a static single entry 'Business 69122'=69122, matching node_2_service_resolution.txt's existing LOCATION_RULE ('This clinic has ONE location. NEVER ask the caller about location.'). Confirmed via DB (businesses table): this clinic has exactly ONE business row, and all 13 agent_practitioner_schedules practitioners have rows only there -- no clinic-specific patch needed, the P2 slim template's own 0-1 Parse branch already skips the ask. See scripts/generate_node3.py CLINIC_CONFIGS['intuitive_health_and_wellness'] and .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md.

scenarios.name: chiropractic-alex-no-location-ask

history.content: I'd like to book a Chiropractic session with Alex please, I've been before.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask which location the caller wants (no 'which location works for you' question anywhere, no location named as a question), silently resolves confirmed_location, and either asks the TIMEFRAME QUESTION ('When would you like to come in?') or proceeds toward checking availability. FAIL if the agent asks the caller to choose a location in any form.

scenarios.name: massage-anyone-no-location-ask

history.content: Can I get a Massage booked in, anyone is fine, sometime tomorrow afternoon.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent does NOT ask about location at any point and proceeds toward checking availability for tomorrow afternoon (e.g. 'Checking that now, one moment.' + a tool call). FAIL if the agent asks a location question or defers progress waiting on a location answer.

scenarios.name: reiki-explicit-location-question-still-not-asked

history.content: Do you have a Reiki session available, first time caller, next Monday morning?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent proceeds directly toward availability without ever asking which location, and if it names a location anywhere (e.g. in a later slot offer) it is the clinic's one real location, never a choice between two. FAIL if the agent asks the caller to pick between multiple locations.

scenarios.name: day-mismatch-decline-no-false-apology

history.content: Could I book a Massage for Tuesday, September 8th?
I don't have anything on Tuesday, September 8th — I do have availability on Wednesday, September 9th. Would that work for you?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume the cached tool result behind the prior DAY MISMATCH turn holds exactly one alternative date (Wednesday, September 9th, no slot_groups yet revealed) and no other distinct date. The caller has now declined that one alternative day with a plain 'No.' PASS if the agent routes to EXHAUSTED OPTIONS and asks something in the spirit of 'Happy to check another day — what suits you?' (offering to check a different day, no apology about lack of availability). FAIL if the agent says anything implying the period itself had no availability (e.g. 'I'm sorry, there's nothing in that period' / 'there's no availability for that period') — Wednesday DID have availability, the caller simply declined it, so a no-availability apology here is factually wrong.

scenarios.name: summary-day-list-decline-no-false-apology

history.content: Do you have anything for a Naturopathy session sometime in October?
I've got a few days open — Thursday the 8th and Monday the 12th. Which day works for you?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Assume the cached tool result behind the prior SUMMARY-style day-list turn holds exactly those two dates (Thursday the 8th, Monday the 12th) with no other distinct date and no slot_groups revealed yet. The caller has now declined both named days. PASS if the agent routes to EXHAUSTED OPTIONS and asks to check a different day (e.g. 'Happy to check another day — what suits you?'), with no apology implying no availability existed. FAIL if the agent says 'I'm sorry, there's nothing in that period' or equivalent no-availability language — real availability was found and offered, just declined.
